instruction:
Classify the invoice exception. Apply these rules exactly:
- MISSING_PO: the invoice carries no purchase-order reference.
- DUPLICATE_INVOICE: the invoice number appears in the list of invoices already paid.
- CURRENCY_MISMATCH: the invoice currency differs from the purchase-order currency.
- PRICE_MISMATCH: |invoice unit price - PO unit price| / PO unit price exceeds 1%.
- QTY_MISMATCH: |invoice quantity - received quantity| / received quantity exceeds 2%.
- NO_EXCEPTION: none of the above applies.
If more than one rule applies, report the highest precedence:
MISSING_PO > DUPLICATE_INVOICE > CURRENCY_MISMATCH > PRICE_MISMATCH > QTY_MISMATCH.

Apply MATCH POLICY MP-3 to the record and decide what to do with the invoice.

4. Precedence: ESCALATE > HOLD > PAY.

RECORD

Invoice: 50 units at 73.26 each

instruction: Apply POLICY VP-7 to the purchase record. Decide whether it is compliant, and if not, name the single highest-precedence clause that is violated.
body:
VENDOR AND EXPENSE POLICY VP-7
C1 Approval threshold: purchases up to 5,000 require one approver; purchases from 5,001 to 25,000 require two approvers; purchases above 25,000 require three approvers including the Finance Director.
C2 Segregation of duties: the requester may not also approve the same purchase.
C3 Vendor onboarding: payment may only be made to a vendor whose risk assessment is dated within the last 24 months of the purchase date.
C4 Discount authority: a discount above 15% requires Finance Director sign-off.
C5 Expense timing: an expense must be recorded in the period the goods or services were received; recording more than 30 days after receipt is a violation.
C6 Emergency exception: where a documented emergency declaration exists, C1 and C5 are waived. C2, C3 and C4 are never waived.
Precedence when several clauses are violated: C2 > C3 > C4 > C1 > C5.

RECORD
Requester: T. Nakamura
Vendor: Tessera Plastics SpA
Purchase amount: 5564.65
Approvers recorded: L. Ferreira (Category Manager); S. Moreau (Controller)
Vendor risk assessment date: 2024-01-27
Discount granted: 2.8%
Finance Director sign-off on discount: no
Goods received: 2025-04-27
Expense recorded: 2025-05-15
Emergency declaration on file: no

VENDOR AND EXPENSE POLICY VP-7
C1 Approval threshold: purchases up to 5,000 require one approver; purchases from 5,001 to 25,000 require two approvers; purchases above 25,000 require three approvers including the Finance Director.
C2 Segregation of duties: the requester may not also approve the same purchase.
C3 Vendor onboarding: payment may only be made to a vendor whose risk assessment is dated within the last 24 months of the purchase date.
C4 Discount authority: a discount above 15% requires Finance Director sign-off.
C5 Expense timing: an expense must be recorded in the period the goods or services were received; recording more than 30 days after receipt is a violation.
C6 Emergency exception: where a documented emergency declaration exists, C1 and C5 are waived. C2, C3 and C4 are never waived.
Precedence when several clauses are violated: C2 > C3 > C4 > C1 > C5.
